en.title: Total Time of Time Travel
en.description:
Visit a list of years in the given order. Moving between equal adjacent years costs 0; going to a later year costs 1; going back to an earlier year costs 2. Find the total time.

The input protocol and the examples in this batch were compiled by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100); the second line contains n years (1..10000).
en.explanation: Process according to the definite rules above; see the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Compare each pair of adjacent years: count 1 for an increase, 2 for a decrease, and 0 for equal, then sum.
